tagline: STIHL equipment and service for Te Anau
heroSubheading: We stock, service, and support STIHL gear locally
aboutHtml:
We're Chris McKenzie and Alissa Johnston, and we run STIHL SHOP Te Anau. We sell STIHL outdoor power equipment, hold a solid stock of parts, and offer full workshop servicing. Whether you're looking for a new chainsaw, hedge trimmer, or blower, need a repair done properly, or just want honest advice on what gear suits your job, we're here to help you get the right tool for the work.

As your local STIHL shop, we know what works in the Southern region and what our community needs. We take our time with customers, keep the stock you need on hand, and stand behind every piece we sell. Come in and see us Monday to Friday, 8am to 5pm. We're easy to find and glad to help.
